update_vs_toolchain: run the update command to download and configure the Visual Studio toolchain for the current repository
set_environment_and_get_runtime_dll_dirs: set up environment variables for the depot_tools VS toolchain and retrieve runtime DLL directory paths
find_depot_tools: find the depot_tools installation path by searching for gclient.py in the system PATH
get_visual_studio_version: get the configured Visual Studio version from the GYP_MSVS_VERSION environment variable or use the default 2015
get_desired_vs_toolchain_hashes: get the list of desired SHA1 hashes for the Visual Studio toolchain based on the selected version
